```{r processing layers in chunks}
n_layers <- nlyr(pdsi_crop_sideways)
chunk_size <- 500         # process 500 layers at a time
output_dir <- "C:/Users/lam858/CESM2-WACCM/processed_chunks/"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Loop through in chunks
for(start in seq(1, n_layers, by=chunk_size)) {
  
  end <- min(start + chunk_size - 1, n_layers)
  cat("Processing layers", start, "to", end, "\n")
  
  pdsi_chunk_list <- vector("list", end - start + 1)
  
  for(i in start:end) {
    layer <- pdsi_crop_sideways[[i]]
    
    # Transpose + flip vertically
    layer_upright <- flip(t(layer), "vertical")
    
    # Apply land mask
    layer_masked <- mask(layer_upright, land_crop, maskvalues=0)
    
    pdsi_chunk_list[[i - start + 1]] <- layer_masked
  }
  
  # Combine chunk into a SpatRaster
  pdsi_chunk_rast <- rast(pdsi_chunk_list)
  
  filename <- paste0(output_dir, "pdsi_us_chunk_", start, "_", end, ".nc")
writeRaster(
  pdsi_chunk_rast, 
  filename, 
  overwrite = TRUE,
  filetype = "NETCDF"
)
  
  cat("Finished layers", start, "to", end, "\n\n")
}
```

```{r precision crop}
#gosh there was probably a cleaner way to do this

# Correcting raster coordinates
pdsi_us_shifted <- shift(pdsi_us_upright, dx = -201, dy = -5)
ext(pdsi_us_shifted)

states <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE)
states_vect <- vect(states)
conus_states <- states_vect[!states_vect$STUSPS %in% c("AK","HI","PR"), ]
conus_buffer <- buffer(conus_states, width = 2) #cause it was getting cut off at the top, can just plot the pdsi mask if i want

pdsi_us_crop <- crop(pdsi_us_shifted, conus_states)
pdsi_us_mask <- mask(pdsi_us_crop, conus_states)

plot(pdsi_us_mask[[1]], main = "PDSI Continental US Layer 1")
plot(conus_buffer, add = TRUE)
```

```{r assigning time}
#it doesn't have time, just various bands, which I the data records say are monthly
#The PDSI_CMIP6 dataset provides NetCDF files containing the estimated PDSI from each CMIP6 model (Table 1)43. The monthly dataset spans from 1850 to 2014 for historical period and from 2015 to 2094 under four climate change scenarios, with a re-gridded spatial resolution of 1°.

n_bands <- nlyr(pdsi_us)  
start_date <- ymd("1850-01-01")
time_vector <- seq.Date(start_date, by = "month", length.out = n_layers)
```

```{r cube into long}
pdsi_long <- as_tibble(pdsi_us_mask, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add layer names
layer_names <- names(pdsi_us_mask)
pdsi_long <- pdsi_long %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(layer_names),
    names_to = "layer",
    values_to = "pdsi"
  )

pdsi_long <- pdsi_long %>%
  mutate(
    layer_index = as.integer(gsub(".*_(\\d+)", "\\1", layer)),
    time = time_vector[layer_index]
  ) %>%
  select(x, y, time, pdsi) 

#rename columns for convenience
pdsi_long <- pdsi_long %>% rename(lon = x, lat = y)
```

```{r checking on the dataframe}
summary(pdsi_long$pdsi)
any(is.na(pdsi_long$pdsi))
range(pdsi_long$time)

ggplot(pdsi_long %>% filter(time == as.Date("2015-01-01")), aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = pdsi)) +
  geom_raster() +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PDSI January 2015")
```

```{r summer averages}
#to align with delila

summer_average <- function(pdsi_long_data){
  pdsi_long_data %>%
    mutate(month = month(time), year = year(time)) %>%
    filter(month %in% c(6, 7, 8)) %>%
    group_by(year, lon, lat) %>%
    summarise(PDSI_Summer_Avg = mean(pdsi, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

summer_pdsi <- summer_average(pdsi_long)
head(summer_pdsi)
```
